newsitem.title: FRANCE: Eurotunnel up on talk debt deal near.
newsitem.headline: Eurotunnel up on talk debt deal near.

text.p: Shares in Eurotunnel were up 12 percent in late trading on market rumours that the Channel Tunnel operator was close to striking a deal with its banks.
Brokers said the rumours were sparked by an article in the London Evening Standard, which said the parties had hit a snag over the conversion price of securities that would be part of the deal.

The share was up one franc (19 cents), or 12.35 percent, at 9.10 francs in heavy volume of 9.5 million shares at 1435 GMT. Eurotunnel said on September 9 that it hoped for a deal with its creditor banks by the end of the month.
